description: This file defines the RuntimeMessagingTrace class, which extends MessagingTrace, and provides detailed logging and instrumentation for messaging-related events within the Orleans runtime, including handling of message forwarding, rejection, deadlocks, and errors.

classes.name: RuntimeMessagingTrace
classes.description: A sealed class responsible for tracing and logging messaging events in the Orleans runtime, including handling of invalid activations, deadlocks, message rejection, forwarding, and errors.

methods.name: OnDispatcherReceiveInvalidActivation
methods.description: Logs and handles the event when an invalid activation is received in the dispatcher.

methods.name: OnDispatcherDiscardedRejection
methods.description: Logs and handles the event when a message rejection is discarded.

methods.name: OnDispatcherRejectMessage
methods.description: Logs and handles the event when a message is rejected.

methods.name: OnDispatcherForwarding
methods.description: Logs and handles the forwarding of a message to another address.

methods.name: OnDispatcherForwardingFailed
methods.description: Logs and handles the failure of message forwarding.

methods.name: OnDispatcherForwardingMultiple
methods.description: Logs and handles multiple message forwarding requests.

methods.name: OnDispatcherTargetFailed
methods.description: Logs and handles the failure to address a message, with specific error filtering.
